newsitem.title: USA: US panel approves 'Farmer Mac' and FCA nominations.
newsitem.headline: US panel approves 'Farmer Mac' and FCA nominations.

text.p: The Senate Agriculture Committee approved and sent to the floor nominations to fill vacancies on the Farm Credit Administration board and the "Farmer Mac" board, it was announced Tuesday.
Ann Jorgenson, of Garrison, Iowa, was approved for the FCA board. The agency regulates the federally chartered Farm Credit System.
Lowell Junkins, of Waukee, Iowa, was approved for the board of Farmer Mac, the Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corp, created in the 1980s to develop a secondary market in agricultural mortgages.
